he DeepSeek Harness GUI
# @Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings
English | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) companion plugin that adds a **Hindsight 记忆设置** page to Settings, so
`~/.hi
ndsight/coding-agent.json` can be edited from the GUI instead of by hand.

It is a companion on purpose. `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` mounts as a **subpath row**
(`
…/coding-agents/dsh`), and DSH's client module system only attaches a browser half to the row whose
specifier is the bare package name — so that package cannot carry a settings page without changing h

ow
every existing user mounts it. Nor does it declare any `Config`: it imports nothing from dsh and
resolves its settings from its own file, which the shipped settings form (schema-derived, persisted

into the profile patch) cannot reach. This package therefore ships its own page and its own host
ser
vice, and leaves the plugin untouched.
## Install

**From GitHub** — the package is consumed straight from this repository, and its
`@vectorize-io/hind
sight-coding-agents` dependency is installed with it, so one install gets both:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the **desktop app** (the profile the Electron shell owns) the CLI refuses by design; install from
the GUI instead — **Settings → Plugins → install**, and paste the same spec:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The 40-character commit this resolves to is pinned by the package manager's lockfile, so a later
`gi

t push` does not silently change what you run: re-install (or update) to move it. Git installs
build
nothing — the compiled `lib/` is committed — so the install is a checkout, not a build.
Naming it with the scope is optional. `github:Echo-Note/dsh-hindsight-settings` installs it under th

e
name in this package's `package.json`; to force a different key, use the npm alias form, which is

what
this repository's own dry-run used:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**From a local checkout** (while editing this package):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`link:` (not `file:`) is the right spec for a package you may edit: `file:` copies a snapshot into t

he
profile, `link:` symlinks it, so a rebuilt browser half is picked up on the next page load.
### The one manual step
A package's bundle is mounted only when the profile selects it in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and dsh's o

wn
plugin-manager README states that "an unselected plain dependency is left out" — the manager list

s
bundles a dependency supplies but does NOT select them. So after installing this package, enable
*

*Hindsight** once in **Settings → Plugins** (installing the bundle by name,
`dsh plugin --profile <p
rofile> add @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents`, does the same thing).

`dsh` has no bundle-depends-on-bundle field to express this (`DshManifest` carries only
`manifestVer

sion`, `bundle.patch`, `client`, `engines.dsh`), and the alternative — our patch inserting
Hindsight

's row directly — would compose the same row twice when its own bundle is also enabled,
because patc
h `insert` appends without deduplicating entry ids.

The host half, the `./typert` manifest and the browser bundle are all read at startup, and dsh's
plu

gin manager notes that "package replacements require restarting the process to load a fresh
JavaScri
pt module generation" — so **restart once** after installing.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The host publishes one Cordis service; its `./typert` manifest exposes `describe` and `apply` to t

he
page (`docs/api-gateway.md`).
- The page renders every field from `src/fields.ts` — the single de

claration of the config surface —
and writes back only what changed. A field the user clears is sent

as `null`, which removes the key
so the setting falls back to the environment variable, then to the

plugin's own default.
- Fields are grouped into one tab per section, plus a **按项目（banks）** tab. A b

ank tab edits
`banks.<id>`, which is how upstream lets one repository differ from the shared top lev

el; opening a
bank calls `describe({ kind: "bank", id })` and saving calls `applyScoped(...)`. `path

s.<dir>` is
listed read-only.
- A field the file does not set is still shown with its **effective**

value — the plugin default —
labelled as such, while a cleared cell still means "remove the key". No

thing is written until a cell
actually changes.
- Secrets are never sent to the page: `apiToken` sho

ws as set-but-blank ("已设置（不显示明文）"), typing
replaces it, and only the explicit 清空 button removes it.

This mirrors dsh's own settings service,
where a `role('secret')` value is kept out of form response

s.
- Nothing goes through the DSH settings form or the profile patch. An earlier revision tried to m

irror
the file into this plugin's own `Config` so the shipped form would show it; a real install ref

used
that write with _"HMR transactions cannot be nested"_ (the row is mounted inside the loader's
t

ransaction, an `AsyncLocalStorage` scope that even timers inherit), and the form never served the
na
mespace. Talking to the file directly is both simpler and the documented path for host state.
## Safety
- Managed keys only: keys this package does not know, and the nested `banks` / `paths` / `harnesses`

sections, are preserved verbatim.
- `null` removes a key; there is no other way to delete, and a fi

eld the page never sends is untouched.
- Writes go through a temp file + rename, at mode `0600` — th

e file can hold `apiToken`.
- A file that cannot be parsed is **never** overwritten: the page report

s it and disables saving.
- An invalid value (wrong type, unknown key, a file-only nested map) is re

fused before the disk is
touched.
## Interface fields

`mapPathToBank`, `pages`, `customPages`, `recallOptions`, `retainMetadata`, `defaultBankConfig`,
`ha

rnesses` and the deprecated `autoReflect` are shown **read-only** in a group tab: they are nested
ma

ps a single form field cannot express, and upstream documents them as file-only. The page says so
pe

r field rather than hiding them. `banks` and `paths` are not read-only: the bank tab edits
`banks.<i
d>` through a scoped write, and the file's `paths` sections are listed read-only.
## Precedence and when an edit takes effect

Upstream resolves `defaults → HINDSIGHT_* → the file's top level → harnesses.<name> → banks.<id> /
